section.11: The Rites of Hajj (Kitab Al-Manasik Wa'l-Hajj)

11.name_native: The Rites of Hajj (Kitab Al-Manasik Wa'l-Hajj)

hadiths.text: AbuMijlaz said:I asked Ibn Abbas about a thing concerning the throwing of stones at the jamrahs. He said: I do not know whether the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) threw six or seven pebbles
